The L85A1 is the Primary Service arm of the British Military.
Accurate and Modern, it is let down by serious reliability issues and design flaws.
Requires its Carryhandle Iron Sights or SUSAT Scope to be effective.

The M16A1 was the primary service Rifle from 1969 to 1986.
Despite being replaced many remained in Reservist and NG stockpiles.

The Primary US Service Rifle since it replaced the A1 in 1986.
Orignally requested and adopted by the USMC, implementing changes as a result of Veitnam.
Controversially it replaced Automatic Fire with a 3 round Burst.
